objective: qualify scalable Q/R/F measurement instruments so PM effect labels are learnable; this is not a ceremonial human review and not a PM pass

supersedes.reason: unused V1 lacked behavioral anchors and its Risk UI defaulted unseen severities to zero

historical_human_review_lessons_applied: atomic fields are more reproducible than overall impressions
forced A/B without tie or unresolved creates false certainty
one or unidentified reviewer cannot establish human gold
adjudication does not rewrite pre-adjudication agreement
task-mismatched historical labels cannot be pooled
duplicate reviewer views do not increase independent sample size
missing or untouched risk fields cannot be interpreted as safe

asset_inventory.lesson: task-mismatched rows and derivative copies cannot be pooled

d2_pairwise_measurement.lesson: pairwise preference remained criterion-sensitive even with tie; it cannot be the only quality truth

v3_atomic_eligibility.lesson: bounded atomic questions with explicit evidence were substantially more reproducible

h1r_dual_review.lesson: good overall raw agreement can hide a broken component and construction-codebook co-adaptation

minimum_rs_sanity.lesson: single unidentified forced-choice review is only descriptive sanity evidence

support_need_adjudication.lesson: adjudication is useful for resolving observed disagreements but cannot retroactively create high IAA

human_provenance_requirement.missing_or_model_provenance: valid reviewer diagnostic only; never human evidence, human gold, or formal human adjudication

quality_effect_reference.scale: behaviorally anchored 1-5; choose nearest 1/3/5 anchor, use 2/4 only between adjacent anchors
quality_effect_reference.primary_quantity: within-rater same-state same-seed ON composite minus OFF composite
quality_effect_reference.why: within-rater contrast cancels much of each person's strict/lenient level and directly matches the PM treatment effect
quality_effect_reference.absolute_cross_rater_scores: secondary instrument-reliability evidence, not direct PM labels
quality_effect_reference.listen_only_goal_definition: accurate low-burden accompaniment can advance the current conversational goal without advice

risk_measurement.construction_intent: sampling and sensitivity diagnostic only; never human truth or PM effect data

scalable_source_split.rule: deterministic evidence may establish a narrow event; it may not declare all unflagged responses safe

function_measurement.projection: FUNCTIONAL iff all three are YES; any NO is NONFUNCTIONAL; any UNRESOLVED is UNRESOLVED
function_measurement.unrelated_response_risk: recorded only under Risk and cannot erase an otherwise realized candidate function

truth_precedence.human_independent_labels: primary calibration evidence only after human-human instrument gates pass
truth_precedence.central_adjudication: third identified human resolves only observed disagreements after both independent files freeze
truth_precedence.codex_or_researcher_content_choice: forbidden as an unregistered tie breaker
truth_precedence.risk_construction_intent: sampling and sensitivity diagnostic only; never overrides human judgment
truth_precedence.old_llm_judgments: kept closed until both human files and adjudication are frozen

quality.failure: anchors or construct remain unstable; do not qualify LLM Quality and do not train Quality effect labels from this packet

function.failure: function codebook remains ambiguous; stop effect expansion

risk.failure: semantic Risk is human-only or claim is narrowed to deterministic risk families

general: if the human-human instrument gate fails, stop before comparing LLM; no human gold exists
if the human instrument passes, consensus/adjudicated human reference controls this calibration sample
LLM is qualified per task and per risk family, never by pooled overall accuracy
a disagreement is an error-analysis row, not an invitation for Codex to choose whichever result helps PM pass
llm_vs_human_resolution.quality_pass: LLM absolute scores may generate development soft effect targets; within-rater human ON-OFF direction remains audit reference
llm_vs_human_resolution.quality_fail: obtain more anchored human paired labels or drop/narrow learned Quality claim; never substitute unqualified pairwise LLM
llm_vs_human_resolution.function_pass: LLM may provide mechanism diagnostics, never causal value by itself
llm_vs_human_resolution.function_fail: use typed executor/deterministic adherence fields and human-confirmed subset; do not scale ambiguous Function labels
llm_vs_human_resolution.risk_pass: LLM may screen ordinary development rows; all material positives, LLM-human disagreement samples and sealed claims retain human review
llm_vs_human_resolution.risk_fail: no LLM semantic Risk labels; retain deterministic risk events plus human evaluation, or narrow the paper claim

relation_to_pm_learning.purpose: qualify label generators and identify which outcome dimensions are learnable at scale
relation_to_pm_learning.pm_pass_definition_unchanged: held-out 16-action policy comparison against always-off, fixed-high, transparent rule, old V1.0 where replayable, and cost-matched fixed
relation_to_pm_learning.no_measurement_pass: no effect expansion and no PM training for that construct
